character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
Production-ready pixel art character sprite for a 1990s shopping-mall horror roguelite.

CHARACTER:
Young adult male mall employee, slightly exaggerated human proportions, tired expression, messy brown hair, faded burgundy retail polo shirt with tiny blank name-tag shape, khaki pants, black work sneakers, simple wristwatch. Ordinary and believable, not heroic or fantasy-styled. Slightly hunched posture like someone trapped working an overnight mall shift.

GAME VIEW:
3/4 top-down perspective for a 2D action roguelite.
Character must read clearly from a medium-close gameplay camera.
Consistent body proportions and silhouette in every animation frame.

PIXEL ART STYLE:
Detailed late-16-bit / early handheld-era pixel art.
Clean, crisp pixel clusters.
Selective dark outlines rather than thick outlines everywhere.
Strong material highlights and readable folds.
Controlled texture.
Minimal dithering.
No anti-aliasing.
No blurred pixels.
No painterly rendering.
No modern vector-art look.
Slight exaggeration for readability while remaining recognizably human.

SPRITE REQUIREMENTS:
48x64 pixels per animation frame.
Transparent background.
Pixel-perfect hard edges.
Character centered consistently in every frame.
Consistent feet position and ground contact.
No baked-in floor, background, lighting, drop shadow, text, UI, borders, or labels.

Create 4 directional idle poses:
- facing down / toward camera
- facing left
- facing right
- facing up / away from camera

Then create a 6-frame walking cycle for each of those four directions.

Animation should feel smooth and natural rather than chibi or bouncy.
Arms should remain visually distinct enough that separate weapon/equipment overlays can later be attached.
Keep the torso and shoulder area easy to read for an independent 8-direction weapon layer.

LIGHTING:
Neutral base sprite lighting designed to accept dynamic in-game lighting later.
Subtle cool fluorescent mall-light influence only.
